label: Claude PA, literal exp-routes.mjs configuration
reasons: Matched balanced elite cost rises from -0.07 to 1.95 terminal party HP; direct fight cost rises from 0.50 to 4.60 HP.
Mixed balanced healing increases from 1.33 to 23.33 percent while retaining 100 percent completion.
Boss remains 5.73 turns balanced, with phase II actions increasing from 1.14 to 1.62.
V1 increases attrition but leaves balanced elite route cost at 0.07 HP.
V3 adds only 0.067 mage HP loss on mixed balanced routes while reducing risky aggressive completion from 53.33 to 49.33 percent. Do not implement it.
limitations: Defensive remains very strong; no claim that all strategies are equally effective.
Mage attrition increases modestly; do not tune to equal hero losses or to the target win rate.
Healing changes heuristic lethal-threat decisions; extra HP is not monotonically beneficial to the aggressive bot.
Human tactical interest and fairness need playtesting.
confirmationPolicy: Confirm frozen V0/V1/V2/V3 on disjoint holdout; no tuning in response.
